map.💡 天然气热值约 10 kWh/m³；计算流量 = 热负荷 ÷ 热值；住宅同时工: 💡 The calorific value of natural gas is about 10 kWh/m³; design flow = heat load ÷ calorific value; the residential simultaneity coefficient is 0.7~0.8.

map.灶具总功率=台数×单台功率、热水器同理；总额定=二者之和；计算负荷=总额定×同时: Total cooker power = number × power per unit, and likewise for water heaters; total rated = the sum of the two; design load = total rated × simultaneity coefficient (0.7~0.8 for residences); design flow = design load ÷ calorific value (natural gas ≈ 10 kWh/m³); look up DN15~DN40 from the flow.
map.灶 2 台×3.5kW、热水器 1 台×20kW、系数 0.8：总额定 27.0: 2 cookers × 3.5kW, 1 water heater × 20kW, coefficient 0.8: total rated 27.0kW, design load 21.6kW, flow 21.6÷10=2.16 m³/h, which lands on DN20 (<4 take DN20).
map.同时工作系数取多少？: What value should the simultaneity coefficient take?
map.住宅一般 0.7~0.8，多器具不同时满负荷；公共建筑按设备同时使用率取值，取: For residences it is generally 0.7~0.8, since many appliances never reach full load at the same time; public buildings take the simultaneous usage rate of the equipment, and using 1 would badly oversize the result.
map.热值用 10 还是 36？: Should the calorific value be 10 or 36?
map.天然气低热值约 36 MJ/m³≈10 kWh/m³，流量用 kWh 值（10）: The lower calorific value of natural gas is about 36 MJ/m³≈10 kWh/m³; the flow uses the kWh value (10) and divides directly to get m³/h; if MJ is used you must divide by 36 — do not mix the units.
